title: Wave 4 V1 Duplication Hunter Audit
description: Read-only audit across all 24+ app plugin crates (framework/plugin/*/rs/lib.rs) for residual violations of SDK-only mechanisms after Wave 4 migration: local (non-imported) tree_item/tree_item_desc/tree_item_with_action/tree_item_with_action_draggable, selection_ids, ActionMeta-building meta( helper, new_app(/new_app_with_registry(, direct MemoryBackbone::pair( instead of testkit::paired_apps, hand-rolled Labels struct+EN/DE consts+resolver instead of app_labels!/LocaleLabels, hand-rolled (id,en,de)->HashMap label map instead of localized_label_map. Distinguish genuine unmigrated duplicates from legitimate documented exceptions (e.g. puzzle icon-based tree_item_with_action). Report structured findings list.
summary:
Root cause: Graph::the_kit_snapshot_store (used by materialized_kit_for_workspace to compute theKit.kit) was seeded once in Graph::new() with the default empty kit projection and never refreshed by any of the direct-hydration paths (bundle install, projection install). Since materialized_kit_for_workspace always replays that stale envelope on top of mutable_kit, any custom kit name/data set via install was clobbered back to the default "the kit" the moment theKit.kit was queried. Rename-based tests passed previously only because an explicit rename operation gets appended to the snapshot store's applied edits via record_operation_in_open_transaction, masking the bug.

Fix: added Graph::reseed_kit_snapshot_store_from_mutable_kit() and called it after every place that hydrates mutable_kit/initial_kit directly — Graph::new (refactored to use the new helper), kit_backbone::graph_new_overlay_from_initial_projection_json, DevBackboneBundleDoc::hydrate_into_graph, and worker::ParentStore::install_projection_json — so the snapshot envelope always matches the current baseline before materialization replays it.

Verified: `cargo test -p compose-store sidecar_install_create_accepts_full_kit_store_bundle_doc` now passes (was failing with left="the kit" / right="BundleInstallName"). Full compose-store suite passes. Full `compose --lib` suite was also run with and without the fix (temporarily reverted then reapplied) to isolate impact: the same 16 tests fail identically, with byte-identical panic messages/line numbers, in both cases — confirming those are pre-existing failures unrelated to this change (likely concurrent in-progress work elsewhere in this shared file), not something introduced by this fix.
